sourceFacts: Exact wrapper props/slots/native output from sources/react-api-inventory.json and pinned code.
contentAlternative: The visible status/category text carries meaning without color or icon interpretation.
updatesAndDescendants: The default span has no stored selection or activation lifecycle. Parent rerenders change its text. useRender may deliberately supply an anchor/button; that native element must retain its own naming, keyboard and event semantics.
referenceDecision: The default reference is informative text. Interactive render overrides use native link/Button contracts, not a new badge-specific toggle protocol.
keyboard: This default content wrapper does not install a keyboard listener or roving focus. Native links/buttons/inputs in the chosen children retain their own documented semantics. Label delegates native focus through its associated control.
naming: The HTML projection identifies all required visible content/labels. No unnecessary ARIA role/name is imposed on native text, headings, kbd or tables.
